messages:
Aisha: Noticed a surprise $14.1k GPU hit on the central billing yesterday. Looks like `internal-eval` was billed to prod. Can someone pull labels and confirm?
BillingBot: Alert: Unusual GPU spend detected. project=internal-eval, delta=$14,112. Incident FIN-9876 created.
Tom: Running a quick bigquery pull: `SELECT project_id, labels, cost FROM billing_export WHERE project_id='internal-eval' AND usage_start_time BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 36 HOUR) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()` -> label `billing_group=prod-central`, `team=unlabeled`.
Priyanka: If this is actually internal testing, we should reassign cost to Search team via internal journal. Cloud refund is an option but slow. Recommend journal + showback correction for this month.
Sandeep: We need to check Search team's commit. Will this put them over their reserved GPU budget? @Aisha pls confirm.
Aisha: Search reserved commit ~ $18k/month, so this offsets most of it but is tight. I'll flag Search PMs for approval. Can finance pre-approve the transfer so reports aren't blocked?
Tom: Found the root cause: terraform var in `projects/internal-eval/main.tf` had `billing_account = var.prod_billing`. I pushed PR to correct to `var.internal_test_billing` and added a CI assertion: `env != \"prod\" || billing_account == var.prod_billing`. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4123
Priyanka: Finance can accept a journal entry if we get the billing CSV + eng owner email + PR link. Aisha please upload the CSV slice for the 24h window. We'll label FIN-9876 as \"intercompany cost reallocation\".
Aisha: Uploaded CSV to Drive: /finance/gpu-transfers/1907001122-internal-eval.csv. Added PR link to the ticket. @Priyanka what GL should we use?
Priyanka: Use GL 6102 (Cloud compute - internal transfers). I'll create the journal and route approvals to @Sandeep and @Search-pmo.
Sandeep: Approve reallocation to Search. Include note: \"misrouted billing due to config error; PR applied; CI added.\"
BillingBot: FIN-9876 status updated to awaiting_journal_entry. Note: you can still open vendor refund with cloud-support@vendor.com (MPN 12345) if desired.
Aisha: Will update Search PM and close the loop in the ticket.
Tom: Added a nightly monitor job to detect non-prod projects pointing at prod billing. :white_check_mark:
Priyanka: Checklist for closing: CSV, PR link, eng owner email, approver confirmations, GL code. Once journal posts finance will update showback for the next run.
Aisha: Done 44d FIN-9876 updated. Leaving thread for audit record."
